_about: The plain test theme (job fw-F4, 29 Oct 2026). It is not a look for any game: flat grey panels, a blue square accent, system fonts, no effects but a flat shape per battle effect. tests/theme_test.py builds the game with it (pub_ch1/theme_plain.html) and renders every screen, which proves the engine and the game's content draw only through the theme layer. It also shows the smallest complete theme: every token here and every widget in plain.js (THEME_WIDGETS in src/01a_game.js). art/mark.png exercises theme art (themeArt('mark')).
name: Plain (test theme)
